title: Construct a Card
prompt: Create Card(name, cost) with instance attributes name and cost. Example: Card("Xbow", 6).cost == 6.
tests:
card = Card("Xbow",6)
assert getattr(card,"name",None) == "Xbow", "Card must store its name"
assert getattr(card,"cost",None) == 6, "Card must store its elixir cost"
assert Card("Skeletons",1).cost == 1, "each Card must keep its own cost"

title: Damage a Unit
prompt: Create Unit(hp) and take_damage(amount). Assume nonnegative numbers; clamp HP at zero. Example: Unit(100) takes 130 damage and has hp == 0.
tests:
a = Unit(100)
b = Unit(200)
a.take_damage(30)
assert a.hp == 70, "100 HP minus 30 damage should leave 70"
a.take_damage(100)
assert a.hp == 0, "overkill must not create negative HP"
assert b.hp == 200, "damaging one instance must not damage another"
hint: Store the result of max(0, self.hp - amount) back on self.

title: Give a Tower a target
prompt: Using the supplied Unit, create Tower(damage) with shoot(target), calling target.take_damage(self.damage). Example: a 20-damage tower changes 100 HP to 80.
tests:
u = Unit(100)
t = Tower(20)
t.shoot(u)
assert u.hp == 80, "a 20-damage shot should leave 80 HP"
t.shoot(u)
assert u.hp == 60, "a second shot should apply damage again"
hint: target is a Unit object, so call its method using a dot.

title: Make an immutable options record
prompt: Use @dataclass(frozen=True) to define Options with annotated fields card_choice: str = "argmax" and card_ratio: float = 0.7. Example: Options().card_ratio == 0.7.
starter:
from dataclasses import dataclass
# TODO decorate the class and declare the fields
class Options:
    pass
tests:
from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError, is_dataclass
o = Options()
assert is_dataclass(o), "Options should be a dataclass"
assert o.card_choice == "argmax" and o.card_ratio == 0.7, "match the requested defaults"
assert Options(card_ratio=0.5).card_ratio == 0.5, "construction can override a default"
caught = False
try:
    o.card_ratio = 0.2
except FrozenInstanceError:
    caught = True
assert caught, "frozen options must reject later field assignment"
hint: The decorator goes immediately above class; annotated fields go inside it.
